moderation.reportReceived.body:
Thanks — this report has gone to Winkly's moderation team. We review every report and may remove content, limit or suspend an account, or decide no action is needed. Anyone we act against is told what we did, why, and how to appeal.

For an urgent safety issue you can also email us.
